title: Polio at thirteen months
summary: He fell down the back steps at thirteen months and was ill, and Russell notes children now get shots.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yeah, I imagine so. How old were you when you had bullying all night?
Yeah, I was walking, fell down the back step. There were three kids in the blockhead. I come out bed and all of them.
Yeah, you were lucky to get through as good as you did. Now they have all those shots and things.
Oh yeah, they got all that.
